description: Figure 5 is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating performance gain (in percent) on tasks achieved through predictive rollout search for three model architectures under two supervision conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categorical model names “GPT-4o,” “Claude-3.5-Sonnet,” and “Qwen2-72B-VL,” arranged left to right, and the vertical axis is labeled “Performance Gain (+%)” with a linear scale spanning approximately 0 to 30, with tick marks at regular 5-unit intervals. Each model category has two adjacent bars corresponding to the legend at the top: “Strong Supervision” shown as a purple bar with diagonal hatching, and “Weak Supervision” shown as a solid light-purple bar. For GPT-4o, the strong-supervision bar reaches about 25% while the weak-supervision bar is about 5%; for Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the strong-supervision bar is about 10% and the weak-supervision bar is about 3%; for Qwen2-72B-VL, the strong-supervision bar is about 15% and the weak-supervision bar is about 5%. The bars are not displayed as stacked, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the color/hatching used to distinguish the two supervision types.
